propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through one Pydantic Agent operation with approved shared request budget
Retry context must preserve complete failed response on proven fit and omit whole otherwise, never truncating authoritative input or stored history
Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal behavior, typed exhaustion, and final-failure artifacts
Successful operations report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once; fallback/downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events without competing usage counters
Bespoke structured-output retry loop removal is deferred pending compatibility suite and authorized Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries
RP-01 epic scope is exclusive; RP-02 through RP-06 require independent ticketization; RP-07 through RP-28 remain unapproved
